Implemented the AssertJ upgrade fix.

Changed:
- [pom.xml](/app/pom.xml): bumped `assertj.version` from `3.16.1` to `3.17.1`.
- [Node.java](/app/json-unit-core/src/main/java/net/javacrumbs/jsonunit/core/internal/Node.java): added `toString()` for `Node.KeyValue` so AssertJ 3.17.1 renders JSON map entries correctly.

Verification:
- `mvn -DskipTests compile` passes.
- `mvn -pl tests/test-base -am test` runs but fails 2 existing visible tests because their expected AssertJ error message still says `JsonList` while 3.17.1 now reports `ArrayList`. I did not edit tests, per constraint; this matches the expected post-upgrade test expectation shift.
